user_query: How does LINE(2nd) compare with node2vec in terms of the kind of proximity or neighborhood information each method emphasizes, and which method is reported to achieve the better overall word analogy score?
llm_response: LINE(2nd) emphasizes second-order proximity: it tries to preserve similarity in nodes’ neighborhood distributions, so two nodes are close if they have similar neighbors even if they are not directly connected. node2vec, by contrast, learns embeddings from biased random walks and captures a mix of local neighborhood structure and broader structural context, balancing breadth-first and depth-first exploration. In the reported comparison, node2vec achieves the better overall word analogy score.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the standard definitions of LINE(2nd) and node2vec and the commonly reported comparison that node2vec performs better on the overall word analogy task.
